title: Integrative multi-omics analysis identifies CCDC69 as a marker associated with germinal center B-cell infiltration in TNBC: development and validation.

snippet: Although coiled-coil domain containing 69 (CCDC69) has been implicated in tumor biology, its role in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) and immune regulation remains unclear. Bulk transcriptomic data, single-cell RNA sequencing datasets, and spatial transcriptomics were used to investigate the role of CCDC69 in TNBC. Germinal center B-cell (GCB) signature...
